User asks "What is today's gold price in US?" They want current market data. We cannot provide real-time info; we should respond with disclaimer. Possibly ask if they need historical or approximate? Provide general guidance.

We can say I don't have live data but you can check reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc. Also mention typical range. No calculation needed. So no tool call.
